G_menu_lifecycle.flow: consumer resource -> client/server mz_menu export -> normalize/register/show -> SendNUIMessage -> web render -> NUI callback -> option callback/event/serverEvent/command -> consumer owner -> close or subsequent ShowContext
G_menu_lifecycle.open: OpenContext registers then ShowContext; ShowContext validates ID and stored context.
G_menu_lifecycle.close: CloseContext or NUI close clears current ID/movement, releases focus, and restores global theme; NUI close runs onExit lifecycle.
G_menu_lifecycle.back: NUI posts current ID; Lua invokes onBack/onBackEvent or shows the menu parent.
G_menu_lifecycle.replace: No named replace API; showing another context while one is open replaces CurrentContextId and preserves movement mode.
G_menu_lifecycle.refresh: No explicit refresh API; consumers re-register and/or ShowContext.
G_menu_lifecycle.focus: SetNuiFocus plus SetNuiFocusKeepInput; movement and legacy focus exports control it.
G_menu_lifecycle.escape: Dialog Escape cancels; context Escape closes rather than traversing parent.
G_menu_lifecycle.resource_stop: Only mz_menu's own stop clears local current/dialog/movement and focus state.
G_menu_lifecycle.invalid_callback: Unknown request ID returns false internally; NUI callback still acknowledges ok before resolution.
G_menu_lifecycle.duplicate_open: No guard; same ID overwrites ContextStore and opens latest normalized content.
G_menu_lifecycle.nested_menu: Parent is a menu ID link; no explicit stack; theme traversal uses seen-set and depth limit 32.
